notes: Session completed. Fixed UI glitching with insight navigation by swapping ValueKey for didUpdateWidget. Fixed severe infinite scroll loop in chat history by implementing a strict _hasMoreMessages data boundary. Updated and successfully compiled all app icons and splash screens. App built successfully but failed install due to user's device being full. Ready for handoff to a fresh context window to handle any final polish or backend syncing.
key_decisions: Wrapped native-dependent Firebase initialization (Crashlytics) in try-catch in main.dart to prevent complete app death if native SDK integration is incomplete.
Transitioned from Firebase Storage to Cloudinary for image hosting to avoid 'Pay as you go' billing requirement.
Used TextEditingController in IntlPhoneField instead of relying on initialValue to guarantee reliable state persistence across widget rebuilds.
Opted for a local visual update for added contacts in AddMemberSheet prior to building the full backend syncing logic to unblock UI testing.
Used didUpdateWidget instead of ValueKey for smoother insight navigation state transitions.
